title: Instructions for the Gnostic
english: He should speak. It is necessary that the gnostic be neither surly nor unapproachable; for the one is ignorant of the words of things coming to pass, and the other is unwilling that all men be saved and come to the knowledge of the truth (2π 3:7). Pay attention to yourself, lest for the sake of gain, or to be well-liked, or for the sake of passing glory, you should say something of the secret things and be cast out from the sacred precincts, just as he himself in the temple was selling the pigeons' young (Matt 21:12). Do not theologize without reflection, and never define the divine; for terms belong to things that have come to be and are composed.

.............................................. that he who has been tried by malice hates malice, and the trial of abandonment is a relative thing. ............................ The teachers should always say to you: 'Friend, ascend upward; for it is shameful for you, having ascended, to be dragged down again by those who hear.' The lover of silver is not the one possessing money, but the one being carried away by these; for they say the steward is a logical purse.

He exhorts to respect the elders, but to restrain the bellies of the young; for the former are the spiritual, while the latter, the more excessive, are the bodily, and demons contend against them. Bind the mouths of those babbling in your ears; and do not be amazed when being accused by many; for this is the temptation from demons; for the gnostic must be free from hatred and malice, and from being unwilling. It has perhaps been written that he who heals himself by healing men through the Lord [is a certain type]; for what the gnostic approaches as a medicine, he provides to his neighbor somewhat, but he heals himself by necessity. Let the one who is higher regarding judgment be hidden from the worldly and the young.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: On Intellectual Error and the Four Virtues
english: A word, producing contempt easily; for the rational soul will not equal the pain of being condemned for its ignorance.

Saint Paul, treating the body as a slave, says: do not neglect your diet in your life, and do not despise impassibility in a body that has been humbled by suffering. Do not worry about food or clothing, but remember the Levite Abner who, having received the ark of the Lord, became rich from the poor and glorious from the worthless.

Every proposition or genus has either a predicate, or a difference, or a species, or a property, or an accident, or a composition of these; but nothing of the said things can be grasped regarding the Holy Trinity. Let the unspeakable be worshipped in silence.
A temptation of the knower is a false opinion standing regarding the existing as if it were not existing, the non-existing as if it were existing, and the existing as if it were something else.

We have learned from the righteous Gregory that there are four virtues and their contemplation: prudence and courage, temperance and justice; and he said the work of prudence is to contemplate the noetic and holy powers without words, for wisdom alone has handed them over to be made manifest; courage is to hold fast to the truths and to fight, and not to step into non-entities; temperance he defined as receiving the seeds from the first farmer and repelling the sower; justice, again, is to render to each according to his due, some announcing darkly, some signifying through riddles, and some even making things manifest for the benefit of...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Models of Knowledge and Discipline
english: Of simpler things. Basil the Cappadocian is the pillar of truth. He says that diligent study and training hold fast the knowledge coming from men, while justice, impartiality, and mercy bring near the knowledge coming near from the grace of God. The former can even receive the passion-driven, but of the latter, only the passionless are receptive, who behold the inherent light of the mind even outside the time of prayer.

Of the Egyptians, the holy light Athanasius is. He says that Moses stands to set the table in the northern part (Exodus 13:3). Let the knowers recognize who is breathing against them, and let them bravely endure every temptation, and with readiness let them nourish those approaching.

Serapion, the angel of the church of the Themites, used to say that the mind, having been feathered, is perfectly purified by spiritual knowledge, but love heals the burning fragments of the soul; and self-control stops the flowing of evil desires.

Didymus, the great and gnostic teacher, says: always train yourself in the discourses concerning providence and judgment, and carry the matters of these in memory; for almost all stumble in these things. And you will find the discourses concerning judgment in the distinction of bodies and worlds; but those concerning providence lead us back from the ways of evil and ignorance toward virtue or toward knowledge.
Looking always toward the archetype, I strive to write the icons, adding nothing of those who work toward gaining the falling one.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
